name: Kimco Realty Corporation
summary: Kimco Realty is a real estate investment trust (REIT) and leading owner and operator of high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the United States. The company's portfolio is strategically concentrated in the first-ring suburbs of the top major metropolitan markets, including high-barrier-to-entry coastal markets and Sun Belt cities. Its tenant mix is focused on essential, necessity-based goods and services that drive multiple shopping trips per week. The company has specialized in shopping center ownership, management, acquisitions, and value-enhancing redevelopment activities for more than 65 years.
